Author: Birendra Kumar Bench: Birendra Kumar  [2024:RJ-JD:2032]
 HIGH COURT OF JUDICATURE FOR RAJASTHAN AT  JODHPUR  S.B. Civil Transfer Appl. No. 53/
 Sonam W/o Rohit Shrimali, Aged About 35 Years, D/o Ma  Lal Ji Resident Of Care Of Manoharlal Vyas, Lodho Ki   Ghanchiyo Ka Mohalla, Maha Mandir, Jodhpur.

entities.text: HIGH COURT OF JUDICATURE FOR RAJASTHAN AT  JODHPUR
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: Versus  Rohit Shrimali S/o Shree Vijay Shankar, Aged About 38  Resident Of Khandiya Kua, Pushkarna School, Bikaner.
For Petitioner(s) : Mr. Dilip Singh Ba  For Respondent(s) : Mr. Hari Shanker
S  HON'BLE MR. JUSTICE BIRENDRA KUMAR Order 12/01/2024 Petitioner is the wife of the sole respondent.

The petitioner has sought for transfer of Case No. 368/2022, a proceeding under Section 9 of the Hindu Marriage Act from the Family Court at Bikaner to Family Court at Jodhpur on the ground that the petitioner is residing at Jodhpur, which is about 250 kms. away from Bikaner.
Moreover, two other cases under the Domestic Violence Act and under Section 498A of IPC is going on at Jodhpur.
Learned counsel for the respondent has no objection in allowing the prayer of the applicant.
Accordingly, prayer of the petitioner stands allowed and it is directed that the pending case be transferred to Family Court at Jodhpur.

(BIRENDRA KUMAR),J 10-sumer/-
